parts.name: C · Review 7: topic vocabulary · tr.121
parts.instructions: Write a word from the box in each gap. There is one word you will not use. Box: compensation · debit · deposit · dividend · mortgage · overdraft · payment · pension · sum

items.stem: It'll take me 25 years to pay off the ____. Then the house will be mine!
items.explanation_vi: Mortgage là khoản vay mua nhà.

items.stem: We pay all our bills by direct ____, so we don't have to spend hours in long queues.
items.explanation_vi: Direct debit là ghi nợ trực tiếp.

items.stem: We're paying for the car in instalments. In fact, we made the first down ____ yesterday.
items.explanation_vi: Down payment là tiền trả trước.

items.stem: When the insurance policy matures, you can either have a one-off lump ____ payment, or receive a certain amount per month for ten years.
items.explanation_vi: Lump sum là khoản trả một lần.

items.stem: My grandfather used to be in the army, so he gets a small serviceman's ____ every month.
I never seem to have any money left in the last week of the month. Maybe I should arrange a/an ____ with the bank.
We ask that you pay a 10% ____ now, and the balance on receipt of the goods.
The judge awarded Mrs Thompson £300,000 ____ for unfair dismissal.
